policy.ja: 公開済みの固定入力・実行・出力・数値判定を結ぶ共通案内です。解析解・独立参照・保存則・残差を区別し、実行終了と数値条件の合格を別々に記録します。原子2例は1つのrunnerを共有し、各条件を別に判定します。これらは全問題台帳から選んだ代表例であり、全問題へ再加算したり、版をまたぐ自動検査数を合算したりしません。
policy.en: A common guide connects public fixed inputs, execution, outputs and numerical acceptance. Distinguish analytic solutions, independent references, conservation and residuals, and record process completion separately from numerical decisions. Two atomic cases share one runner and receive separate decisions. These examples are selected from the full problem inventory, not added to it again; repeated automated tests across editions are not summed.

assumptions.ja: 一定速度a=1、平均1、振幅0.2、基本モード。既存difference_stepを前進Eulerで呼び、実際の|C|≤0.5になる等間隔時間刻みを使う。入力で速度・正弦波・区間・格子を指定できるが、非ゼロ速度、正振幅、十分なモード解像とCFL条件を検査する。
assumptions.en: Constant speed a=1, mean 1, amplitude 0.2 and the fundamental mode. Existing difference_step is called with forward Euler and equal time steps with actual |C|≤0.5. Inputs expose the speed, sine, interval and grids, with nonzero speed, positive amplitude, mode resolution and CFL checks.

scope.ja: γ=1.4、左右(ρ,u,p)=(1,0,1)/(0.125,0,0.1)、初期不連続x=0.5、t=0.2の標準問題。80/160セルの区分一定Godunov型＋HLLC＋SSPRK3を自己相似Euler解と比較する。
scope.en: Standard γ=1.4 Sod tube with left/right (ρ,u,p)=(1,0,1)/(0.125,0,0.1), initial jump x=0.5 and t=0.2. Compare 80/160-cell piecewise-constant Godunov-type/HLLC/SSPRK3 updates with a self-similar Euler solution.

assumptions.ja: 理想気体、1次元一様格子、正の密度・圧力、CFL=0.3。名付き標準問題の物理定義はJSONに明示し、異なる定義は拒否する。参照の圧力は既存exact_eulerの区間二分法で評価する。Godunov原報の厳密Riemann一段更新そのものではない。
assumptions.en: Perfect gas, one-dimensional uniform grid, positive density/pressure and CFL=0.3. The named benchmark's physical definition is explicit in JSON; incompatible definitions are rejected. Reference pressure is evaluated by the existing exact_euler bracketed bisection. This is not the original exact-Riemann one-step Godunov algorithm.

units.ja: 密度・速度・圧力・長さ・時間は無次元。エネルギーはE=p/(γ−1)+ρu²/2。

scope.ja: [-5,5]で衝撃波と密度正弦波の干渉をt=1.8まで計算。100/200点の特性FD WENO-Zを800点の同じ実装と比較し、参照との差と近似境界収支を別々に記録する。
scope.en: Evolve shock/entropy-wave interaction on [-5,5] to t=1.8. Compare characteristic FD WENO-Z at 100/200 points with the same implementation at 800 points, separately recording reference disagreement and approximate boundary balance.

assumptions.ja: γ=1.4、初期不連続x=−4、左(ρ,u,p)=(3.857143,2.629369,10.33333)、右ρ=1+0.2sin(5x),u=0,p=1。初期不連続を各格子の界面へ合わせる。点値FD、大域LF分割、界面固定Roe特性基底、WENO-Z指数2、ε=10^-6、SSPRK3、CFL=0.3。
assumptions.en: γ=1.4, initial jump x=−4, left (ρ,u,p)=(3.857143,2.629369,10.33333), and right ρ=1+0.2sin(5x), u=0, p=1. The initial jump aligns with a face on every grid. Pointwise FD, global LF splitting, face-frozen Roe characteristics, WENO-Z exponent 2, ε=10^-6, SSPRK3 and CFL=0.3 are used.

units.ja: 長さ・時間・Euler変数は無次元。固定εはこの無次元流束の尺度に対する値で、任意単位系へ自動転用しない。
units.en: Length, time and Euler variables are nondimensional. Fixed ε refers to this nondimensional flux scaling and is not automatically transferable to arbitrary units.

boundaries.ja: 端点初期値を固定したゴースト値。連続の遠方流束を差し引いた収支には、静止した非一様密度を固定ゴーストで扱うFD境界離散化誤差が残る。丸め誤差保存とは区別する。
boundaries.en: Ghost values are fixed to initial endpoint states. Balance against continuous far-field fluxes retains FD boundary discretization error for the nonuniform stationary density with fixed ghosts; this is distinct from roundoff conservation.

description.ja: 高解像度の保存変数の点値を各100/200点の格子中心へ線形補間する。誤差はそれぞれ同じ場所・t=1.8で平均する。CSVは200点の計算・参照を並べる。近似収支の許容値0.2%は固定境界の離散化誤差を許すためであり、密度誤差0.15の判定とは別。
description.en: Higher-resolution conserved point values are linearly interpolated to each 100/200-point grid's centers. Errors are averaged at matching locations and t=1.8; CSV pairs the 200-point solution and reference. The 0.2% approximate-balance allowance accommodates fixed-boundary discretization and is separate from the density-error bound of 0.15.

failure_scope.en: The 800-point solution is a same-method numerical reference, not an exact solution or independent solver. The mean-density difference bound of 0.15 is an educational structure-resolution criterion, not a high-accuracy certification. Only decreasing discrepancy under grid doubling is tested; no formal order is assigned. Positive outputs and counted rejections do not establish positivity for every input.

reference_notes.ja: 高解像度の保存変数の点値を各100/200点の格子中心へ線形補間する。誤差はそれぞれ同じ場所・t=1.8で平均する。CSVは200点の計算・参照を並べる。近似収支の許容値0.2%は固定境界の離散化誤差を許すためであり、密度誤差0.15の判定とは別。
reference_notes.en: Higher-resolution conserved point values are linearly interpolated to each 100/200-point grid's centers. Errors are averaged at matching locations and t=1.8; CSV pairs the 200-point solution and reference. The 0.2% approximate-balance allowance accommodates fixed-boundary discretization and is separate from the density-error bound of 0.15.

scope.ja: 既存Thomas解法で −u''=π²sin(πx) を15/31/63内部点で解き、解析解sin(πx)、独立な差分残差、格子幅半減の次数を別々に確認する。

scope.ja: 単位正方形のsin(πx)sin(πy)を参照し、CG/MGは15/31/63内部点、P1 FEMは4/8/16分割で細分化。FDの最大誤差と真の残差、FEMの要素内L2誤差とH1半ノルムを独立に評価する。
scope.en: Reference sin(πx)sin(πy) on the unit square; refine CG/MG through 15/31/63 interior nodes and P1 FEM through 4/8/16 subdivisions. Independently evaluate FD maximum errors/true residuals and FEM element-interior L2/H1-seminorm errors.

assumptions.ja: 定係数 −Δu=2π²sin(πx)sin(πy)。CG/MGは同じ五点SPD系を相対許容値1e-11で解く。FEMは既存の連続P1・対角三角形分割・ILU(0)付きGMRES。FEM誤差は別のDuffy写像と8点積Gauss求積で評価する。
assumptions.en: Constant-coefficient −Δu=2π²sin(πx)sin(πy). CG/MG solve the same five-point SPD system to relative tolerance 1e-11. FEM uses existing continuous P1, diagonally split triangles and ILU(0)-GMRES. FEM errors use a separate Duffy map and eight-point product Gauss quadrature.

units.ja: 領域長1・uとも無次元。L2は値の面積積分ノルム、H1半ノルムは勾配誤差の面積積分であり、節点最大誤差や単純な配列ノルムと区別する。
units.en: Dimensionless unit-length domain and u. L2 integrates value error over area; H1 seminorm integrates gradient error, separately from nodal maximum or plain array norms.

boundaries.ja: 正方形[0,1]²の全周でu=0。FEMの組立て残差は内部自由度だけで評価し、境界反力は除く。
boundaries.en: u=0 around [0,1]². FEM assembled residuals use interior degrees of freedom, excluding boundary reactions.

scope.ja: −u''=λexp(u)、β=1・λ=2β²/cosh²(β/2)の小さい枝を零初期値から解く。31/63/127内部点で解析解、独立に再評価した非線形残差、2次格子収束を確認する。
scope.en: Solve the lower branch of −u''=λexp(u), with β=1 and λ=2β²/cosh²(β/2), starting at zero. Check the analytic solution, recomputed nonlinear residual and second-order refinement on 31/63/127 interior nodes.

assumptions.ja: 既存の残差十分減少による減衰NewtonとILU(0)付きGMRES。解析解u=2log[cosh(β/2)/cosh(β(x−1/2))]。βtanh(β/2)<2で小さい枝を選び、初期値は全点零。内部Newton制御は非線形許容値1e-10、最大30反復。
assumptions.en: Existing residual-decrease damped Newton and ILU(0)-GMRES. Analytic u=2log[cosh(β/2)/cosh(β(x−1/2))]. βtanh(β/2)<2 selects the lower branch and all initial unknowns are zero. Nonlinear tolerance is 1e-10 with at most 30 Newton iterations.

units.ja: xとuは無次元。λは本規約で無次元化され、次元座標なら逆長さ²に対応する。残差は境界を除いた全内部点のEuclideanノルム。
units.en: Dimensionless x and u; λ is nondimensional here and scales as inverse length squared for dimensional coordinates. Residuals use the Euclidean norm of interior equations.

scope.ja: 既存の単位質量・単位角振動数の調和振動子をvelocity Verletで進める。20時間単位、200/400/800刻みの解析解比較、元のエネルギー偏差、時間反転を出力。
scope.en: Advance the existing unit-mass, unit-frequency harmonic oscillator with velocity Verlet. Compare analytic states over 20 time units at 200/400/800 steps, original-energy deviation and reversal.

assumptions.ja: H=(q²+p²)/2、(q₀,p₀)=(1,0.2)。固定刻み、非散逸1自由度。初期値・終端時刻・刻み数は入力に明記。最大刻みh=0.1はhω<2の安定域。
assumptions.en: H=(q²+p²)/2 and (q0,p0)=(1,0.2); one nondissipative degree of freedom, fixed steps. Inputs explicitly provide initial state, final time and counts. Largest h=0.1 lies in h*omega<2.

units.ja: 無次元化し質量m=1・角振動数ω=1。pはこの規約の正準運動量、エネルギーは(q²+p²)/2。
units.en: Nondimensional unit mass m=1 and angular frequency omega=1; p is canonical momentum and energy is (q²+p²)/2.

boundaries.ja: 時間初期値問題。空間境界なし。出力時刻0〜20の両端を含む。
boundaries.en: Temporal initial-value problem with no spatial boundary; output includes times 0 and 20.

description.ja: CSVは最細刻みの時刻ごとに数値・解析のq,pとエネルギーを整列。観測次数は終端状態誤差から、エネルギー偏差は全保存時刻から計算。
description.en: CSV aligns numerical/analytic q,p and energy on the finest time grid. Observed order uses endpoint-state errors; energy deviation uses all recorded times.

description.ja: 独立な解析式q=q₀cos t+p₀sin t、p=−q₀sin t+p₀cos t。数値解の細格子値を厳密解とは呼ばない。
description.en: Independent analytic q=q0*cos(t)+p0*sin(t), p=-q0*sin(t)+p0*cos(t); no fine numerical solution is called exact.

description.ja: 既存のVerlet手法項目の文献。今回の実行で原論文の全計算を再現するわけではない。

failure_scope.en: Reject h*omega>=2, nonfinite inputs, unknown method/system and non-doubling counts. Accurate reversal does not establish long-time phase accuracy or exact original-Hamiltonian conservation. Not validation of nonlinear oscillators or many-body systems.

scope.ja: 既存のL安定2段SDIRK2でy′=−1000(y−cos t)−sin t、y(0)=1をt=1まで解く。解析解、固定刻み細分化、別の強減衰1段問題を検査。

assumptions.ja: rate=1000、1000/2000/4000ステップでrate*h=1,0.5,0.25。固定γ=1−1/√2と既存Newton段階解法を使用。別の減衰はy′=−10⁸y、y(0)=1、h=1。適応刻み法ではない。

scope.ja: exp(x)を次数2/4/6/8でL2射影し、同じ次数のGLL節点補間と比較する。実装の32点Gaussとは別の64/96点求積と独立Legendre再帰式で係数・直交性・誤差を確認する。
scope.en: L2-project exp(x) at degrees 2/4/6/8 and compare GLL interpolation at the same degrees. Check coefficients, orthogonality and errors using separate 64/96-point rules and an independent Legendre recurrence, versus 32-point projection quadrature.

assumptions.ja: 参照区間[−1,1]、重み1のLegendre内積。GLLはp+1節点。高次求積の一致を参照精度の補助検査とし、一般関数の厳密積分とは主張しない。出力201点は誤差積分用の求積点とは別。
assumptions.en: Reference interval [−1,1] and unit-weight Legendre inner product; GLL has p+1 nodes. Agreement of higher-order rules supports reference accuracy but is not an exact-integration claim for arbitrary functions. The 201 output points are separate from error quadrature.

units.ja: 参照座標ξとexp(ξ)は無次元。L2誤差は重み1の区間積分から計算する。

boundaries.ja: 補間・射影の問題で物理境界条件はない。GLLの端点節点はPDE境界の施行を意味しない。

scope.ja: 入力JSONに保存した19粒子の周期CIC–FFT–CIC計算。質量、内力和、単粒子自己力、整数箱長移動を確認し、別の正弦密度の解析的周期Poisson場と照合。
scope.en: Periodic CIC–FFT–CIC calculation for 19 particles stored explicitly in input JSON. Check mass, net internal force, single-particle self-force and integer-box translation; separately compare a sinusoidal density with analytic periodic Poisson fields.

assumptions.ja: 3次元立方周期箱L=1、G=1、24³格子、正の質量で総和1。座標・質量は全値を入力に保存し、実行時の乱数生成はない。連続k²のFFT逆演算と同じCIC配置・補間を用いる。
assumptions.en: Three-dimensional periodic cube L=1, G=1, 24³ mesh and positive masses summing to one. All positions/masses are stored explicitly; no runtime random generation. Continuum-k² FFT inversion with matched CIC assignment/interpolation.

units.ja: 基準長L=1、総質量M=1、G=1。密度はM/L³、ポテンシャルはGM/L、加速度はGM/L²、力はGM²/L²。
units.en: Reference length L=1, mass M=1 and G=1. Density: M/L³; potential: GM/L; acceleration: GM/L²; force: GM²/L².

boundaries.ja: 3方向周期。∇²φ=4πG(ρ−〈ρ〉)、φ̂(0)=0。偶数格子の各微分軸のNyquist成分を0にする既存実装。孤立境界の直接和とは異なる。
boundaries.en: Periodic in all three axes: Laplacian(phi)=4*pi*G*(rho-mean(rho)), phi_hat(0)=0. Existing implementation zeros the unpaired Nyquist derivative mode along each even-grid axis. This differs from isolated direct-sum boundaries.

description.ja: CSVは粒子ごとの座標・質量・加速度・力。正弦密度の独立解析場検査はJSONの集計値に保存。PM格子細分化を粒子力の解析誤差として誤表示しない。
description.en: CSV stores each particle's coordinates, mass, acceleration and force. Independent sinusoidal-field diagnostics are JSON metrics. No mesh refinement is misrepresented as analytic particle-force error.

description.ja: 別入力密度ρ=ρ₀+A cos(kx)に対するφ=−4πGA cos(kx)/k²、a_x=−4πGA sin(kx)/k。粒子群の厳密な周期力参照ではない。
description.en: For separate rho=rho0+A*cos(k*x), phi=-4*pi*G*A*cos(k*x)/k² and ax=-4*pi*G*A*sin(k*x)/k. Not an exact periodic particle-force reference.

description.ja: 既存PM項目の文献。今回のCIC–FFT方式・境界・検査範囲は入力と実装に明示。
description.en: Existing PM-method reference; this recipe explicitly fixes its CIC–FFT formulation, boundaries and check scope.

failure_scope.ja: 非正質量、非有限入力、G≠1、不適切な格子・正弦モード、非整数箱長移動を拒否。質量・内力和・自己力の一致だけでは個々の粒子力の精度を保証しない。周期直接和、短距離補正、Ewald・P3M・PME・SPME、粒子時間発展は実装しない。
failure_scope.en: Reject nonpositive masses, nonfinite inputs, G!=1, invalid grids/sinusoidal modes and noninteger box shifts. Mass/net-force/self-force consistency alone does not establish individual particle-force accuracy. No periodic pair-sum reference, short-range correction, Ewald/P3M/PME/SPME or particle evolution.

scope.ja: 既存の2次元MAC投影法・中心対流項・明示SSPRK2を使用。16²/32²/64²で解析的減衰渦と比較し、最細格子はCFL半減でも確認。
scope.en: Use existing two-dimensional MAC projection, centered convection and explicit SSPRK2. Compare analytic decaying vortex on 16²/32²/64² grids and halve CFL on the finest grid.

assumptions.ja: 単位密度、[0,2π)²、ν=0.1、T=0.5。u₀=sin x cos y、v₀=−cos x sin y。既存ソルバーの移流・拡散安定性に基づくCFL=0.2、時間感度検査は0.1。
assumptions.en: Unit density, [0,2*pi)², nu=0.1 and T=0.5. u0=sin(x)cos(y), v0=-cos(x)sin(y). CFL=0.2 uses the solver's combined advection/diffusion stability estimate; temporal sensitivity uses 0.1.

units.ja: 無次元。速度振幅1、座標周期2π、粘性νの次元は長さ²/時間。圧力は単位密度での比圧力。平均運動エネルギーは〈u²+v²〉/2。
units.en: Nondimensional velocity amplitude one and coordinate period 2*pi; viscosity has length²/time units. Pressure is kinematic pressure at unit density. Mean kinetic energy is <u²+v²>/2.

boundaries.ja: 2方向周期、圧力平均0。u・vは異なるMAC面、圧力はセル中心。Poissonは連続k²ではなく離散DG記号を逆演算。
boundaries.en: Periodic in both axes, zero-mean pressure. u/v occupy different MAC faces and pressure cell centers. Poisson inverts the discrete DG symbol, not continuum k².

description.ja: CSVは(i,j)をC順に並べ、u面・v面・圧力中心それぞれの座標、数値解と解析解を別列に保存。MAC速度を同じ位置の成分と誤解しない。JSONにエネルギー履歴と時間感度を保存。
description.en: CSV uses C-order (i,j) rows with separate coordinates and numerical/analytic values for u faces, v faces and pressure centers; the components are not collocated. JSON includes energy histories and temporal sensitivity.

description.ja: u=sin x cos y e^(−2νt)、v=−cos x sin y e^(−2νt)、p=(cos2x+cos2y)e^(−4νt)/4。平均運動エネルギーはe^(−4νt)/4。

description.ja: 既存投影法項目のChorin文献。今回のMAC配置とSSPRK2の具体形は公開実装に固定。

name.ja: Brio–Wu：HLLDと保存的に粗視化した数値参照
name.en: Brio–Wu: HLLD and a conservatively restricted numerical reference

scope.ja: γ=2、Bx=0.75の1次元理想MHD衝撃波管をt=0.1まで計算。HLLD＋MC＋SSPRK2の64/128セルを512セルの数値参照と比較し、密度・圧力・縦磁場・保存収支・切替回数を記録する。
scope.en: Evolve the one-dimensional γ=2 ideal-MHD shock tube with Bx=0.75 to t=0.1. Compare 64/128-cell HLLD/MC/SSPRK2 with a 512-cell numerical reference, recording density, pressure, longitudinal field, balances and fallback counts.

assumptions.ja: μ0=1、左右(ρ,vx,vy,vz,p,Bx,By,Bz)=(1,0,0,0,1,0.75,1,0)/(0.125,0,0,0,0.1,0.75,−1,0)。初期不連続x=0.5をセル界面へ合わせる。既存solve_1dの固定定義とJSONの一致を検査し、変更した物理定義は拒否。CFL=0.35。
assumptions.en: μ0=1, with left/right (ρ,vx,vy,vz,p,Bx,By,Bz)=(1,0,0,0,1,0.75,1,0)/(0.125,0,0,0,0.1,0.75,−1,0). The initial jump x=0.5 is face-aligned. JSON must match the unchanged solve_1d benchmark definition; altered physical definitions are rejected. CFL=0.35.

units.ja: すべて無次元。磁気エネルギーはB²/2（μ0=1）、熱エネルギーはp/(γ−1)。γ=5/3のOrszag–Tang例とは異なる。
units.en: All quantities are nondimensional. Magnetic energy is B²/2 with μ0=1 and thermal energy is p/(γ−1). This differs from the γ=5/3 Orszag–Tang case.

boundaries.ja: 端値外挿。波が端へ達しないt≤0.1で、8保存量の変化からT(F_left−F_right)を差し引く。全運動量が不変とは仮定しない。1次元で共通のBxを保つ。
boundaries.en: Edge extrapolation. For t≤0.1, before waves reach the ends, subtract T(F_left−F_right) from all eight conserved-integral changes. Total momentum is not assumed constant; the common one-dimensional Bx is retained.

description.ja: 512セルの保存変数を64/128セルへ整数ブロック平均し、その後にprimitive変数へ変換する。CSVは128セルごとに計算値とそのセル平均に対応する参照値を配置。正値性、縦磁場10^-12、境界流束収支10^-10、経験的な誤差減少を別々に判定し、fallback回数を隠さない。
description.en: Restrict the 512-cell conserved variables by integer block averaging to 64/128 cells before converting to primitives. CSV pairs each 128-cell result with its corresponding restricted reference. Positivity, longitudinal-field error 10^-12, boundary-flux balance 10^-10 and empirical error decrease are separate checks; fallback counts remain visible.

description.en: Original HLLD flux paper. The released implementation counts HLLE fallbacks for invalid intermediate states.

failure_scope.ja: 512セル参照も同一solverで、厳密解・独立コード・MHD弱解の一意性の証明ではない。密度差0.03は左密度1に対する3%の平均絶対差を許す教材基準。正値性再試行とHLLE切替は数えるが、再構成の正値スケーリングの作動数は既存APIにない。正値出力だけから一般の保証やゼロ修正を主張しない。
failure_scope.en: The 512-cell reference uses the same solver and is neither exact nor independent, nor a proof of uniqueness of MHD weak solutions. Density difference 0.03 allows a mean absolute discrepancy of 3% of left density 1 for this educational test. Positivity retries and HLLE fallbacks are counted; reconstruction positivity-scaling activations are not exposed by the existing API. Positive output alone certifies neither general positivity nor absence of reconstruction changes.

scope.ja: 非対称な2原子He周期セル・局所GTH・LDA交換＋VWN5。PySCFの解析力（Gaussian基底の微分を含む）を全6座標のエネルギー有限差分とDFTK平面波参照で照合し、力の基底・k点・SCF・FFT収束を分離。BOMDの力供給と短い刻み比較に限定し、長時間NVE・CPMD・一般物質は未検証。
scope.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.

assumptions.ja: 固定した非対称2原子Heセル（5 bohr立方、4価電子、非偏極・整数占有、局所GTH、LDA_X＋VWN5）。PySCFライブラリを使う検証ドライバー。物理的な平衡He物質や長時間MDではありません。
assumptions.en: Fixed asymmetric two-He cell (5-bohr cubic lattice, four valence electrons, unpolarized integer occupations, local GTH and LDA_X plus VWN5). A library-backed PySCF validation driver; not physical equilibrium helium or long-time MD.
